method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (lga-concession.l4, with five regulative rules for the council's duties and permissions) and a seat layer (lga-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a s 580 variation, a ss 577-578 hardship order, a s 582 waiver, a notice served outside its rating year or an impossible share answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Local Government Act 1993 No 30 (NSW), Open Australian Legal Corpus document nsw_legislation:2025-01-01/act-1993-030 (version 2025-01-01, collected 10 March 2025), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1993-030.txt; with the Local Government (General) Regulation 2021, corpus document nsw_legislation:2024-09-02/sl-2021-0460 (version 2024-09-02), as deposited at ../../../local-government-general-regulation-2021/registers/source-bundle/sl-2021-0460.txt (cll 134-136, and cl 127(1)(j) for a reading). Not the current official text and may be out of date: check legislation.nsw.gov.au before relying on it.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lga-concession.l4 ; l4 run lga-seat.l4 ; l4 run lga-cases-pensioner.l4
checks.result: 82 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 3 #TRACEs with an expect line (1 breach by the council, 2 duties pending), each read and as expected; a control copy with one expected value altered reported 2 failures
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the eligible pensioner: the Dictionary definitions of dwelling, eligible pensioner, jointly eligible occupier, quarter and year; Regulation cl 134(a)-(d) (prescribed classes, Commonwealth statuses as facts); s 575(1)-(5) (reduction on application, one-half or the proportional share, the $250 and $87.50 caps, full quarters after becoming eligible, discharge between joint liables); s 576 (as an input instruction); s 579 with cl 135 (application; time by council resolution; continuation without re-application, regulative); s 583 (write-off; recovery only for a wilfully false statement or under s 584); s 584 (end on the last day of the quarter; credit for a full prepayment); s 582 with cl 136 (who the council may relieve, as a permission). Not covered, with an explicit answer: a s 580 variation, ss 577-578 hardship orders, the amount of a s 582 waiver, a notice served outside its rating year. Out: Division 2 postponement (ss 585-599), the rest of the Act and the Regulation, Sydney Water and Hunter Water concessions. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/, veterans-entitlements-act-1986/ and military-rehabilitation-and-compensation-act-2004/ (the Commonwealth statuses that are this encoding's cl 134 inputs); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the eligible pensioner liable (solely or jointly) for council rates and charges on the dwelling they live in
